purpose: Benchmark the exact author Relay v0.2.2 implementation and compare it with canonical source-procedure Relay on matched CSS observations and per-leg gamma assignments.
rate_basis: Prespecified Phase 4 V3 selected rates; B1 p=.07 uses the declared three-leg bounded adaptation. These rates are fixed independently of current V4 outcomes.

controls.native_explicit_gammas: Reconstruct canonical PCG64 later-leg gamma arrays from the manifest and public sample identity; verify hashes against each executed canonical leg before comparison.

sampling.physical_sample_namespace: Same code/rate namespace as the active V4 benchmark; both agreement arms see the same public CSS observation.
sampling.stopping: No outcome-dependent stopping; finish 128 matched shots per code/rate or retain explicit incomplete evidence at the finite wall cap.

reporting.uncertainty: Two-sided exact Clopper-Pearson intervals; Bonferroni across three codes and four paired disagreement metrics at each declared look.
reporting.incomplete: Retain each native timeout, setup failure, and public canonical boundary failure in the denominator accounting; never equate missingness with agreement.

claim_limit: Controlled CSS implementation agreement diagnostic, not bitwise equivalence, source circuit-curve reproduction, or a publication decoder ranking.
